services.name: New patient visit
services.story: The main story: a new patient visit with the doctor, billed to the patient's plan. Nothing is taken. The desk checks the plan, and the patient pays the copay ($40, example) at the front desk; a self-pay patient pays $240 there the same way.

services.name: New patient visit
services.story: The same visit where the office turns on its $20 no-show fee. A card is saved for it, never for a fee-free patient, and the owner confirms any charge.

services.name: Video follow-up visit
services.story: A self-pay video follow-up ($85), paid in full when booking; nothing more after the visit.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.staff: Kit and Rosa (nurse practitioners, with a medical bag)
B.customer: Alex M. (a patient who can't easily leave home) · other patients

services.name: Postpartum check at home
services.story: The main story: a postpartum check at home with a nurse practitioner. Nothing is taken; the practice bills the patient's plan its own way.

services.name: Postpartum check at home
services.story: The same home visit, paid by the patient: nothing is taken, and Rosie texts the $199 bill when the visit is marked DONE.

services_shape: OB-GYN office: a patient books a visit with a named doctor or nurse practitioner (or the next open clinician who takes new patients); a video visit counts as at the office; a home visit by a nurse practitioner for a postpartum check or a patient who can't easily leave home; no walk-in line; same-day sick visits are offered first
questions_before_times: the kind of visit (new, checkup, prenatal, birth control, a home visit)
whether it's a video visit (it counts as at the office)
a health plan or self-pay (only the plan's name here)
for a teen (under 18): whether the teen books alone, where the state's rules allow it
for a home visit: the town, and whether the patient can come to the door
safety_stop: heavy bleeding with dizziness or fainting, severe belly or pelvic pain, chest pain, trouble breathing, or a sudden severe headache, during pregnancy or after birth
first_steps: A health history for a new patient
Consent for a pelvic exam or procedure
license: a state medical license for each OB-GYN doctor and nurse practitioner, and the practice's registration where the state's rules require it; a state or federal registration for any in-office procedure or ultrasound the state names; a home-visit license where the state requires one for care at the patient's home
staff_skills: obstetrics, gynecology, prenatal and postpartum care, contraception and IUD placement, in-office ultrasound, chaperones, Spanish
messages_never: the diagnosis, a pregnancy, the names of tests or procedures, results, medicines, ID numbers and plan details never go in a text: only the secure page; texts say only the practice's name, the day, the time and the place
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
